playstyle: Trade with the strongest thing on the field and eat it. Every point of your health is a resource you take back from the enemy, but only when the hit actually lands. Move with a purpose: the aura you raise and the ground you break are both positional.

abilities.name: Rend
effects: adds one Rend stack: 8 damage per second for 5.0 s
stacks to 3
each new stack refreshes the 5.0 s timer
abilities.notes: The opener. 55 damage plus a burn that lands after the enemy walks away.

abilities.name: Reaping Arc
effects: hits every target inside a 110 degree frontal arc out to 2.8 m
heals the Attacker for 25% of the damage actually dealt
no link is drawn by this ability
abilities.notes: A small self-heal on the arc, paid only for hits that land. 0.35 s wind-up, 6.0 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Siphon
effects: draws a visible link: a red tether line between the Attacker and the target, shown to both teams
heals the Attacker for 35% of the damage actually dealt
a blocked, parried or fully absorbed hit heals 0 and the link flashes for 0.5 s
the link breaks at 12.0 m or after 6.0 s
healing from the link is capped at 90 health per second
abilities.notes: The whole class in one ability: 70 damage, 24.5 health back per clean hit, 3.0 s cooldown. Nothing heals without a landed hit.

abilities.name: Cinder Burst
effects: ground burst inside a 3.5 m circle at 5.0 m
knocks every target back 4.0 m
the knockback breaks every bind and tether on the affected targets
cancels an enemy that is charging a dash
abilities.notes: The escape hatch. Any knockback leaves a bind, so this is the answer to the Templar tether and to the Gunner anchor pull. 14.0 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
effects: an 8.0 m aura around the Attacker for 12.0 s
+25% attack speed inside the aura
+10% movement speed inside the aura
+15% damage taken inside the aura
the aura follows the Attacker and its edge is always visible
abilities.notes: Not a song: a standing zone with a radius. The edge is drawn on the ground so the enemy knows where not to stand.

abilities.name: Scorch Line
effects: a 10.0 m line 1.2 m wide burns for 4.0 s
18 damage per second inside the line
targets inside move 30% slower while they burn
abilities.notes: Lays a lane that cuts a fight in half. 0.4 s cast, and it can be interrupted while it casts.

abilities.name: Feast
effects: consumes the active Siphon link
heals 12% of maximum health instantly
clears all Rend stacks on the Attacker
abilities.notes: The payoff for a landed drain. With no link, or with a link that never healed, it does nothing.

abilities.name: Red March
effects: burst inside a 6.0 m circle around the Attacker
heals the Attacker for 40% of the damage dealt, capped at 220 health
pulls every target 2.0 m toward the Attacker
a Siphon that lands within 3.0 s of the pull heals double
abilities.notes: The self-heal finisher. The pull sets up the drain instead of ending the fight on its own.

abilities.name: Blood Pact
effects: marks one enemy for 10.0 s
the marked enemy takes 20% more damage from the Attacker
the marked enemy deals 20% less damage to the Attacker
the mark is a rune on the target, visible to both teams
abilities.notes: Marks do not stack: a second pact refreshes the 10.0 s timer instead of adding to it.

abilities.name: Wolf Rush
effects: dashes up to 10.0 m to the target
stagger 0.8 s
the dash ends with a free Siphon hit
abilities.notes: 0.4 s charge tell before the dash. The gap closer that keeps the drain fed on a fleeing target.

abilities.name: Crimson Thirst
effects: for 15.0 s every landed hit heals 45% of its damage
each heal taken adds 1.0 s to the duration, up to 6.0 s more
the Attacker cannot be healed above 80% of maximum health while it runs
the Siphon link does not break on range while it runs
abilities.notes: The window where the Attacker wins by not dying: 15.0 s, 40 mana, 90.0 s cooldown.

weakness: Control and range. The Attacker has one knockback and no real crowd control, so a defended group with a healer and a ranged line beats it. Purge of Bonds at 6.0 s cooldown is the direct answer to the class: strip the drain links in one cast and the Attacker has no answer left.
